random.denominator_description: median inter-parent distance of SHA-256-seeded Gaussian vectors (dim 128)
random.interpretation: metric-sensitivity control only: a pass here shows the ratio metric is sensitive, NOT that any biological capability exists

scope_note: I2 r_pair certifies that a representation is sensitive to the planted single-residue edit relative to its inter-protein scale. It does NOT certify biological direction; direction and transferability are tested by I1 (planted recovery) and I3 (ID-equivalence). A pass here is necessary, never sufficient, for a biological capability claim.
